website_meta_description: SOGÉ STUDIO is a Brooklyn, NY based textile design studio, renowned for our fresh and innovative pattern prints in the apparel, home, and accessories industry. Highly regarded for color intuition and the fluidity of artwork, our distinct patterns are created by an elite team of ethnically diverse designers with an integration of mixed media, hand illustration and digital techniques. While always on trend, we’re most importantly setting new ones from our unique point of view and our clients value the confidence of knowing their SOGÉ print is one-of-a-kind. Our designs are highly sought after and have been featured in WGSN numerous times.

About - SOGÉ STUDIO About services the studio About us News exhibits interiors Our Work exhibits contact cards shop prints Facebook instagram ABOUT US OUR STORY SOGÉ STUDIO is a Brooklyn, NY based textile design studio, renowned for our fresh and innovative prints in the apparel, home, and accessories industry. Highly regarded for color intuition and the fluidity of artwork, our distinct patterns are created by an elite team of ethnically diverse designers with an integration of mixed media, hand illustration and digital techniques. While always on trend, we’re most importantly setting new ones from our unique point of view and our clients value the confidence of knowing their SOGÉ print is one-of-a-kind. Our designs are highly sought after and have been featured in WGSN numerous times. oUR FOUNDER At the studio’s helm is Brooklyn-born, Fashion Institute of Technology alumna, Stephanie Ogé. Her innate aesthetic was further developed during her studies at Polimoda in Florence, Italy. After a nearly a decade working as a fashion designer for various sportswear brands in New York City, Stephanie quickly fell in love with patterned textiles, dreaming of one day opening her own studio. It was on a life-altering trip to Jaipur, India - discovering indigenous techniques in natural dyeing and block printing - where her passion for textiles was truly ignited, inspiring her to pursue it full time. A creative visionary, Stephanie finds inspiration in the grit of subway graffiti, ancient tile work, prints found in vintage clothing stores and her many travels around the world. With her talented team of designers, she translates and infuses that inventiveness into the signature prints of SOGÉ STUDIO. FEATURED CLIENTS Get our Newsletter Thank you for subscribing! Oops! Highly regarded for color intuition and the fluidity of artwork, our distinct patterns are created by an elite team of ethnically diverse designers with an integration of mixed media, hand illustration and digital techniques. While always on trend, we’re most importantly setting new ones from our unique point of view and our clients value the confidence of knowing their SOGÉ print is one-of-a-kind.
